doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: De De's birth certificate and the Pierces' marriage license
summary: Allen reads the 1935 marriage license and De De's 1904 birth record.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: I think we'll turn it off a minute long.

This is a marriage license. And it states that Mr. Joseph Lacroix Pierce and Miss Willie Goodson were married on the 28th day of March 1935. And this is recorded in the parish of Orleans. It was recorded April the 9th, 1935. And the same being duly recorded in book number 53. D. Henry Thonazee, is that how you pronounce that? L-A-N-A-U-Z, I guess. And he also recorded something on this page, if I can read it. It's D.D.'s birth certificate, huh?
Lacroix Marine Pierce. Marine. L-M-P. Get up, Briony. Go lay down. Go lay down, Briony.
And he recorded you as Lacroix Pierce, Jr., huh? M-hmm. Book 127, folio, 259, New Orleans, March the 9th, 1904.
And it was born 18th of February.
M-hmm. M-hmm. And it's the same deputy reporter.
The same man, Briony. The same man, Briony.
I was here, huh? M-hmm. M-hmm.
